metadata.title: Classification of analytic $\text{SO}^o(p,q)$-actions on closed $(p+q-1)$-dimensional manifolds II : $p \geq 3$, $q=1,2$
metadata.abstract: This paper provides a classification of analytic actions of the semi-orthogonal groups $\text{SO}^\circ(p,1)$ and $\text{SO}^\circ(p,2)$, for $p \geq 3$, on closed, connected manifolds of dimension $p$ and $p+1$ respectively. It is a sequel to a previous paper, which treats the case $p,q \geq 3$. Adapting Uchida's methods, we explicitly construct analytic actions of $\text{SO}^\circ(p,1)$ on $\text{S}^{p}$ and $\text{S}^{p-1} \times \text{S}^{1}$, and analytic actions of $\text{SO}^\circ(p,2)$ on $\text{S}^{p+1}$, $\text{S}^{p} \times \text{S}^{1}$ and $\text{S}^{p-1} \times \text{S}^{2}$, and we classify them up to analytic isomorphism, using a result of Hitchin and Schneider's classification of analytic $\text{SL}_2(\mathbb{R})$ actions on surfaces. The main result demonstrates that any analytic $\text{SO}^\circ(p,q)$ action, $q=1,2$, on a closed, connected $(p+q-1)$-dimensional manifold is covered by one of the constructed actions or by an action on $\text{SO}^\circ(p,q) \times_P \text{S}^1$, where $P$ is a maximal parabolic subgroup of $\text{SO}^\circ(p,q)$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 低余维SO°(p,q)解析群作用分类
analysis.workSummary: 对p≥3、q=1或2，研究闭连通维数p+q−1流形上的非平凡SO°(p,q)解析作用。模型为列明球面、球面乘积及最大抛物子群P相关的SO°(p,q)×_P S¹，并以等变覆盖描述一般情形。q=2、p=3另有由SO°(3,2)/P_min覆盖的传递作用例外。
analysis.breakthrough: 补足此前p、q均至少3之外的q=1、2分支。
analysis.limitations: 正文第2页引言明确研究非平凡作用；第3页定理1.2保留p=3的最小抛物传递例外。模型作用分类还有最大紧子群以标准方式作用的条件，结论须按解析同构及等变覆盖理解。当前解读结合摘要及第1—3页引言，未逐步审读证明。
